🚀 Week 1 Setup - START HERE

🚀 Week 1 Setup - START HERE

Welcome to AMCP SEO & Marketing Week 1!

This is your entry point. Everything is prepared. You just need to follow the steps.

⏱️ Time Required: ~1.5 hours

📊 Impact: HIGH (enables all future tracking)

🎯 What You’ll Accomplish This Week

By the end of Week 1, you will have:

✅ GitHub repository optimized for search
✅ Google Search Console set up and verified
✅ Google Analytics tracking active
✅ Sitemap submitted to Google
✅ Foundation ready for content marketing

📋 The 4 Tasks

Task 1: GitHub Repository (15 min)

Update repository description and add topics for better discoverability.

Task 2: Google Search Console (30 min)

Set up GSC to monitor how Google sees your site and submit your sitemap.

Task 3: Google Analytics (20 min)

Enable tracking to see who visits your site and where they come from.

Task 4: Sitemap Verification (10 min)

Verify your sitemap is accessible and submitted to Google.

Print this or bookmark it:

GitHub (15 min)

  • Update repository description
  • Add website URL
  • Add 8 topics

Google Search Console (30 min)

  • Create property
  • Get verification code
  • Add code to _config.yml
  • Deploy changes

  • Create GA4 property

  • Get Measurement ID
  • Add ID to _config.yml
  • Deploy changes

Sitemap (10 min)

  • Verify sitemap.xml accessible
  • Confirm GSC submission successful

🎬 Getting Started Right Now

Step 1: Choose Your Path

  • Detailed? → Read WEEK1_SETUP_GUIDE.md
  • Quick? → Use WEEK1_QUICK_REFERENCE.md
  • Status? → Check WEEK1_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md

Step 2: Follow the Instructions

  • Complete all 4 tasks in order
  • Use the checklist to track progress
  • Refer to troubleshooting if needed

Step 3: Verify Everything Works

  • Check GitHub repository
  • Verify GSC shows “Verified”
  • Check GA Real-time dashboard
  • Confirm sitemap submitted

Step 4: Move to Week 2

  • Once Week 1 complete
  • Read: IMPLEMENTATION_CHECKLIST.md Phase 2
  • Start creating blog content

💡 Pro Tips

  1. Do it in order: Tasks build on each other
  2. Save your codes: Copy verification codes and IDs somewhere safe
  3. Wait for deployment: GitHub Pages takes 2-5 minutes to rebuild
  4. Be patient with Google: Indexing takes 1-14 days
  5. Monitor weekly: Check GSC and GA regularly
